name: map-chrome crystal tier — Direction B-refined (2026-08-12 Opus build)
_doc: Self-contained AA declaration for the map-chrome compaction crystal tier. Every color is the SHIPPED build value: glassMapCrystal0/1 from src/theme.ts (light) + src/theme/ThemeContext.tsx (dark), the always-light 0.65 pin literal in MapScreen.tsx / HeatmapLegend.tsx, and the inline inks.

BASES: the map backdrop is unbounded (tiles independent of the JS theme). Every themed surface is declared over #000 AND #FFF in BOTH modes, plus the 5 heat saturants. Bases MUST be opaque; all translucency lives in `stack`.

crystalBar: declared at the MOST TRANSPARENT stop of the engineered gradient (0.60 light / 0.70 dark) — the conservative worst case; it also equals the blur-mode floorColor (a single flat floor is the conservative bound for blur, which only averages toward lighter mixes). So this one declaration covers BOTH material arms of the on-device A/B.
countChip: the count pill fill glassMapCrystal0 (0.70/0.80) painted OVER the bar's own crystal floor — stack[0] nearest base. glassChipInk (#333/#F5F5F5) is the shipped chip ink.

pin065: the disclosure family (HeatmapLegend, heat-notice explainer, locating banner) at the always-light 0.65 white pin, dark ink literals SAME as light (reads identically in every theme). #222 = darkened legend/explainer inks; #414B5A = the close-X glyph (1.4.11 UI, min 3); #333 = the locating banner text.

INK PRICE (Sky's crystal, documented): bar text falls to #222/#F5F5F5 and tool icons to #0E4499/#B4CFFA — the muted grays (inkGlassMuted) and plain brand (inkSelect #0F53BE light) mathematically fail at this transparency; that is why the crystal costs a darker ink.
